headline: NCT DREAM take first 'Show Champion' win with 'Boogie Woogie'
caption:
NCT DREAM won first place on 'Show Champion' with 'Boogie Woogie'.

On the Nov 18 episode of MBC M's 'Show Champion', they beat ATEEZ, IVE, RESCENE and ILLIT to earn their first music show trophy of this promotion. 'Boogie Woogie' is the title track of their 6th full album 'DREAM AFTER DREAM', released Nov 9.

📌 Source: MBC M 'Show Champion'
